```{r function}
# function that takes the gdb output format as string and produces an r data object (LLM-generated)
parse_coeffs <- function(output) {
  x <- str_c(output, collapse = " ")

  number <- "[+-]?(?:\\d+\\.?\\d*|\\.\\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\\d+)?"

  # Extract the contents of coeffs = { ... }
  coeffs_text <- str_match(
    x,
    "coeffs\\s*=\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}"
  )[, 2]

  if (is.na(coeffs_text)) {
    stop("Could not find the coeffs struct.")
  }

  # Extract name/value pairs from coeffs
  coeffs <- str_match_all(
    coeffs_text,
    str_c("(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*(", number, ")")
  )[[1]]

  result <- set_names(
    as.list(as.numeric(coeffs[, 3])),
    coeffs[, 2]
  )

  # Extract top-level position, excluding position_unc
  position <- str_match(
    x,
    str_c("\\bposition\\s*=\\s*(", number, ")")
  )[, 2]

  if (!is.na(position)) {
    result$position <- as.numeric(position)
  }

  return(result)
}

# batch access for the above function, also llm generated
parse_gdb_batch <- function(x) {
  # Split before each "(gdb) print ..."
  blocks <- str_split(
    str_c(x, collapse = "\n"),
    "(?=\\(gdb\\)\\s+print)",
    simplify = FALSE
  )[[1]]

  blocks <- blocks[str_detect(blocks, "\\$\\d+\\s*=\\s*\\{")]

  # Extract the index from validRegressions.at(n)
  indices <- str_match(
    blocks,
     "validRegressions(?:\\.|->)at\\((\\d+)\\)"
  )[, 2]

  result <- map(
    blocks,
    parse_coeffs
  )

  names(result) <- paste0("reg_", indices)

  result
}

# peak fit function
q_reg = function(coeffs, x){
    x = x - coeffs$x0
    b0 = coeffs$b0
    b1 = coeffs$b1
    b23 = 0
    if(coeffs$b1 < 0){
        b23 = coeffs$b2
    } else {
        b23 = coeffs$b3
    }
    exp(b0 + b1 * x + b23 * x * x)
}
```
